name: Input Buffer Demo
description: Input-buffer demo (F6), approximate trajectory prediction, and an optional F8 automatic click assistant with an in-game overlay.

show-trajectory.name: Show predicted trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Draw the dashed predicted path, predicted collisions and landing points. Predictions are approximate.

horizon.name: Prediction horizon (ticks)
horizon.description: How many game ticks ahead to predict. Larger values cost more CPU and are less accurate.

detail.name: Visualization detail
detail.description: 1 = path only, 2 = path + collision/landing markers, 3 = also tick dots.

debug-mode.name: Debug mode
debug-mode.description: Draw the actual player trail (green) next to the prediction and log prediction discrepancies and deaths to the console.

correction-window.name: Auto-click scan range (ticks)
correction-window.description: How far ahead (in ticks) the F8 click assistant looks for the jump window. Larger = more CPU per tick.
